metricDefinitions.prAuc: Average precision from the held-out precision-recall curve (sklearn average_precision_score).
metricDefinitions.brier: Mean squared error of the held-out altered-class probabilities.
metricDefinitions.expectedCalibrationError: Ten equal-width probability bins, weighted by participant count.

prevalence_threshold_forest.thresholdSelection: outer-training-fold altered prevalence; no threshold optimization

prevalence_threshold_hist_boosting.thresholdSelection: outer-training-fold altered prevalence; no threshold optimization

selectionRule: Highest aggregate held-out balanced accuracy, then AUROC, then lower Brier score.

adaptiveSecondPass.change: After the initial evaluation, two training-fold-prevalence operating points were added to reduce unstable threshold fitting with only 12 altered cases.
screenedButNotRetained: fold-local univariate feature selection plus logistic regression
adaptiveSecondPass.interpretation: The higher-sensitivity operating point is useful for hackathon research, but its balanced-accuracy gain is seed-sensitive and is not an untouched confirmation result.

runtimeBlockedReasons: No participant identifiers to audit duplicates or repeated measures
No external, temporal, clinic, geographic, or prospective validation
The target is a coarse historical normal/altered label, not a named semen endpoint
The improved operating point was developed adaptively after reviewing the initial CV
